title: The Complete Guide to Keeping Your Lawn Green Through Every Season
summary: Learn the essential lawn care practices homeowners can follow throughout spring, summer, fall, and winter to maintain healthy grass and improve curb appeal.
detailsSummary: A great lawn isn't luck — it's a system. After thousands of properties, we've found the same handful of moves separate thin, struggling turf from the lush, even lawns neighbors ask about. Here's the full playbook.
body:
Start with your soil

Before applying any fertilizer, it's essential to test your soil thoroughly. The pH and nutrient levels of your soil determine the success of your gardening efforts. Using the wrong fertilizers on soil that isn't properly balanced is a common reason why many DIY gardening projects don't achieve the desired results. Taking the time to understand your soil's specific needs will help you choose the right amendments and ensure healthier, more productive plants.

‍

  • Test pH in early spring and again in fall
  • Aim for a slightly acidic 6.0–7.0 for most grass types
  • Correct compaction with core aeration before seeding

‍

Feed for the season, not the calendar

Lawns require various nutrients throughout the year, depending on the season. Following a slow-release feeding plan based on soil temperature rather than a set calendar date helps maintain consistent growth. This approach prevents the rapid growth and decline cycles that often encourage weeds and diseases to take hold, ensuring a healthier, more resilient lawn over time.

‍

“The single biggest mistake homeowners make is mowing too short. Taller grass shades out weeds and grows deeper, drought-proof roots.”

‍

Mow higher than you think

Adjust your mower to one of its highest settings and avoid cutting more than a third of the grass blade at a time. Keeping blades sharp, mowing regularly, and exercising patience contribute far more to a thick, healthy lawn than any miracle product ever could.

Combine balanced soil, seasonal feeding, and smart mowing, and you'll notice significant improvement within just one season. Prefer to leave it to the experts? Our Lawn Treatments program follows this exact approach on a reliable schedule, ensuring guaranteed results.
